summary: Gentherm Inc filed an 8-K/A to correct a clerical error on a signatory of a First Amendment to its existing Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated February 24, 2026. The amendment includes borrowers (Gentherm, its Texas subsidiary, Medical, GmbH, and Präzision SE), guarantors, lenders, and Bank of America as administrative agent. No special situation exists—this is a routine credit facility amendment, not a merger, acquisition, or other corporate event. The filing explicitly states no offer or solicitation is intended and references a proposed transaction with Modine in disclaimers only, not as the filed event. Watch for any future filings on that referenced transaction.
